title: Davis meets Grusch at the Aerospace Corporation and hands over his data

tellings.quote: I worked for the AOS space Corporation and that's how I met Dave brush right Jay Stratton introduced me to Dave

plain: The physicist Eric W. Davis says he met David Grusch, a whistleblower who later spoke publicly about secret UFO programmes, while Davis was working for a company called the Aerospace Corporation, at its campus in Colorado Springs. He tells Michels that a man named Jay Stratton introduced them, and the story goes that Davis then handed his data over to Grusch.
